approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Let new accounts in and hand out one-time password-reset links. Only HR, the Founder and the Developer can do this, and nobody can approve an account they created themselves.
approvals.pendingEmpty: No accounts are waiting for approval
approvals.pendingEmptyBody: New accounts appear here until someone other than their creator approves them.
approvals.ownAccount: You created this account, so someone else must approve it.
approvals.leadership: Only the Founder or the Developer can approve this account.
approvals.rejectBody: {name} will not be able to log in. This is logged.
approvals.resetsEmptyBody: When someone uses Forgot password, the request shows up here.
approvals.cannotIssue: Only the Founder or the Developer can reset this account.
approvals.directBody: Type the person's work email to create a one-time reset link even if they did not ask.
approvals.linkBodyInvite: Give this link to the person (WhatsApp or phone). They open it and set their password. It works once and expires.
approvals.linkBodyReset: Give this link to the person (WhatsApp or phone). They open it and choose a new password. It works once and expires.
approvals.linkWarning: This link is shown only now and is not stored. Close this window only after you have shared it.
approvals.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the link and copy it by hand
